# `omapac-repo snapshot test`

- **Usage:** `omapac-repo snapshot test <FLAGS>`

Run the test suite on a snapshot and record the result

## Flags
- **`--id <ID>`**
- **`--suite <SUITE>`** — The suite command; the built-in consistency check when omitted
- **`--allow-missing`** — Let the built-in check pass with package files missing
- **`--commit <COMMIT>`** — Record the suite's git commit
- **`--log-url <LOG_URL>`** — Where the log was published
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
